name: Mahan confederacy
events: Baekje invades Silla in the Korean Peninsula, and captures Castle Ugok.
King Giru of Baekje succeeds to the throne of Baekje in the Korean Peninsula.
Baekje invades the outskirts of Silla in the Korean Peninsula.
Gongsun Kang, Chinese warlord of Liaodong, establishes the Daifang Commandery in northern Korea.
The Korean kingdom of Baekje attacks the Mohe tribes.
The manufacture of cultured silk becomes popular from Korea to Japan.
In Korea, the Buyeo Kingdom is absorbed by Goguryeo.
